common_name: Southeast Asian Gracile Fruit Fly (Reduced Tarsal Sex-Comb Teeth)

phenomenon_scale.anatomical_structure: Turing pigment stripe / ocellus wavelength in Drosophila eugracilis (1.5 µm, detail scale)

paleobiology.note: All three chronospecies are extant (0 Ma). Age does not change. At 1.5 µm the Murray parameter gamma, and therefore k_c, changes.

equations: du/dt = D_u laplacian(u) + gamma * (a - u + u^2 v)
dv/dt = D_v laplacian(v) + gamma * (b - u^2 v)
governing_model.critical_wavenumber: k_c^2 = (D_v f_u + D_u g_v) / (2 D_u D_v)
governing_model.gamma_scaling: lambda_c(gamma) = lambda_c(1) / sqrt(gamma) when gamma multiplies the Jacobian
governing_model.boundary_conditions: periodic Fourier domain; margins relax to the homogeneous steady state

chronospecies_contrast.biological_reading: Pandanus-specialist West African fly with female dark/light abdominal morphs. Lower gamma lengthens the inhibitor range and the selected pigment wavelength.
Reduced tarsal sex-comb teeth. Focal detail wavelength is the assigned 1.5 µm ocellus / pigment-granule scale on a 12-wavelength window (17.820 µm).
Fig-breeding fly with a longitudinal sex-comb tooth array. Higher gamma shortens lambda_c so more high-activator foci fit in the same detail window.

reported_in_source: Turing 1952: linear reaction-diffusion instability and a critical wavenumber.
Schnakenberg 1979: the two-species kinetics used here.

Tanaka, Barmina and Kopp 2009 PNAS 106:4764-4769: longitudinal Drosophila sex combs arise either by rotation of transverse rows or by bristle precursors born already longitudinal; mechanisms differ among species.
Yassin et al. 2016 Current Biology 26:2412-2422: female-limited colour dimorphism has recurred in Drosophila (the phenotype class of D. erecta).
Ready, Hanson and Benzer 1976: the Drosophila retina is a periodic neurocrystalline lattice.
reconstructed_in_script: Mapping the catalog detail length 1.485e-6 m onto Schnakenberg lambda_c at gamma=1 by choice of the length unit.
gamma_erecta=0.5 and lambda_ficusphila=1.18e-6 m as the chronoseries contrast at this scale.
Nonlinear spot-lattice wavelength measured by radial FFT, compared with the analytic lambda_c(gamma).
does_not_claim: That 1.485 µm was measured on a D. eugracilis ocellus or sex-comb bristle in any cited paper.
That the gallery JPEG is a photograph or SEM of D. eugracilis (it is the project canonical plate; Wikimedia had no species bitmap).
That D. erecta is a stratigraphic ancestor of D. eugracilis. Position 13/41 is the flattened Holocene chronoseries coordinate supplied for this loop.
The sibling primordium slot parameters (alpha_scale 1.555, beta_offset 0.316, 101 µm) or its incorrect DOI 10.1016/j.ydbio.2009.04.012.
